$schema: RUM ledger record v1 (one line per adjudicated REAL high-stakes analyse run)
problem_slug: short label for the real problem (no confidential detail)
adjudicator_rung: A-crosslab | B-fable | C-panel | D-self  (which independence rung actually ran)
items_raised: int — total observable-backed items the adjudicator raised
items_decision_relevant_after_rank: int (<=3) — surfaced to you after the decision-relevance ranking
would_have_flipped_call: bool — would this have reversed or materially changed your real decision?
operator_agreed: bool — do you, the decision-owner, agree it was a real catch?
discriminating_observable: the checkable fact/test behind a flip (REQUIRED if would_have_flipped_call=true)
notes: one line; what it caught / why it mattered (no confidential detail)
